topic.title: Troubleshooting
topic.shortdesc: Enable debug logging to inspect the requests that AI Positron for Web Author sends to an AI service.

section.title: Enable AI Positron Debug Logging
section.p: If AI Positron cannot connect to a configured AI service, or if you need to verify the structure of the requests sent to the service, enable debug logging for the AI Positron plugin on the Web Author server.

ol.li: Open the Administration Page and locate the Web Author logging configuration. For details, see Locating and Configuring Logs.
Add the following line to the logging configuration:log4j.category.com.oxygenxml.positron=debug
Reproduce the problem, or send the prompt whose request you want to inspect.
Open the Web Author server log and search for entries from the com.oxygenxml.positron package.

section.note: Debug logging can generate a large amount of information and may affect performance. After you finish troubleshooting, remove the added logging configuration and restart the Web Author server.

section.title: Inspect AI Requests

section.note: System prompts, message content, image data, tool descriptions, and credentials are filtered in the AI Positron debug output. Review the logs before sharing them because other server components or custom connectors may use different filtering behavior.
